subject: Portal onboarding: slimline evidence compaction & presign window request
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearsummit.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal onboarding: slimline evidence compaction & presign window request

Hi Lena —

Thanks for agreeing to onboard Clearsummit into your portal for the SOC 2 / SIG intake. We want to keep the upload footprint small and actionable on your side, so the plan on our end is to: 

- Produce a single compressed bundle (tar.gz) per evidence category (SOC2, SIG, CAIQ) rather than dozens of individual files.
- Provide an accompanying manifest (CSV) with filename, SHA256, size, and high-level mapping to questionnaire IDs.

Before we start packing things up, two quick asks so we size the work correctly: 
1) Preferred portal for the intake (Vendr/Whistic/OneTrust/Archer) and any required naming conventions for file prefixes.
2) Maximum presign window you can support for PUT uploads and whether you can create short-lived presign windows scoped to a prefix (we're requesting a 4–6 hour window during a business day).

We plan to target upload by EOD Monday Aug 10PT. Attached is our evidence_manifest_template.csv so you can confirm the fields we will populate. Also attaching our internal presign policy (redwood-presign-policy.pdf) to show lifecycle expectations.

If vendor-side service accounts are required, please advise the principal (email) and minimal IAM role you need — we can either request a short-lived role from our infra team or upload via a pre-signed flow.

Summary next steps:
- You confirm portal + prefix + presign window
- We prepare compressed bundles + manifest and send final filenames + checksums 24h before the window
- You enable presign and we upload during the agreed window

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looping in Rishi and Marissa for upload orchestration.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: evidence_manifest_template.csv, redwood-presign-policy.pdf
From: Clearsummit Security Portal <security@clearsummit.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding: slimline evidence compaction & presign window request

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear plan. We generally prefer accepting bundles via our Vendr integration (we can also accept direct S3 presigned uploads if you need). A few specifics from our side: 

- Portal: Vendr (preferred). If you must use Whistic/OneTrust let us know and we can provide the alternate endpoint.
- Presign window: our console allows up to 72 hours, but for security we recommend <= 24 hours. We can create a scoped presign that is valid for a specific S3 prefix for the window you choose. A 6-hour window in our experience balances reliability + security.
- S3 prefix policy: please use the prefix /redwood-evidence/clearsummit/DEAL-4521/YYYYMMDD/ to make lifecycle rules easier on our side.
- We also require an upload CSV with columns: filename, sha256, size_bytes, category (SOC2/SIG/CAIQ), questionnaire_id (if applicable).
- Service account: create a principal named portal-uploader@clearsummit.io (we will bind a short-lived role to that principal). If you prefer we can create a temporary signed URL for each object instead.

Note: we attached our vendor upload guide (clearsummit-upload-guide.pdf) with screenshots of the Vendr import (fields, sample CSV).

If you can send final filenames + checksums by Monday 08:00 PT we will provision a 6-hour presign window starting 10:00 PT Monday Aug 10. Confirm whether that window works for you and whether your infra team needs any temporary IAM changes.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Security Program Manager
Clearsummit
lena.ortiz@clearsummit.io
